description: The ECON-PowerCI researchers publish a Jupyter notebook associated with their European electricity consumption and carbon-intensity dataset. The own Zenodo record contains one notebook file and states CC BY 4.0, with public access at no cost. It provides a reproducible starting point for preparing daily aggregate demand and emissions series before power-system simulations, including studies using model-pypsa-eur. Coverage follows the European country-level data described by the companion Scientific Data article. A caveat is that the repository metadata alone do not establish every external API, data version or package required to rerun the notebook. The published CSV may reflect a fixed processing date, not a live feed. Notebook cells were not downloaded or executed, so numerical equivalence to the deposited table and continued source availability remain untested. The data deposit is recorded separately.
